description.zh: 用 Manim(3Blue1Brown 那套数学动画的社区版)做教学动画,本机渲染、零生成费用:公式推导、几何关系、函数图像、算法步骤、代码讲解、物理示意。要「一步一步地变」而且必须讲对的内容用它;要真实画面(人物、场景、实拍感)用视频生成模型;要排版精致的图文讲解卡片、数据图表也可以用 Remotion 插件。给结构化内容(每一步的标题、旁白、要点、公式 / 函数图 / 代码)就出讲解视频,不用写代码;更自由的画面写一段 Manim 场景代码(默认不开放,要在插件页勾选)。第一次用前在插件页运行「准备 Manim 环境」。Manim 是 MIT 许可。
description.en: Teaching animations with Manim (the community edition of 3Blue1Brown's maths animation engine), rendered on this computer at no generation cost: derivations, geometry, function plots, algorithm steps, code walk-throughs, physics diagrams. Use it for content that must change step by step and be correct; use a video generation model for realistic footage; the Remotion plugin also suits polished text-and-chart explainer cards. Structured content (each step's title, narration, points and a formula / plot / code) becomes an explainer with no code; anything freer is a Manim scene in Python (off by default — enable it on the plugins page). Run "Prepare Manim" once on the plugins page first. Manim is MIT-licensed.

help.zh: 可选。留空用官方源;国内网络可以填 `https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple`。只在准备环境时用到。
help.en: Optional. Leave empty for the official index. Used only while preparing the environment.

help.zh: 可选。留空时插件在自己的数据目录里建环境、装 Manim;已经用 conda / uv 装好了的,填那个环境里 python 的完整路径,就不再装一份。
help.en: Optional. When empty the plugin installs Manim into its own data directory; if you already have Manim (conda / uv), put the full path of that environment's python here.

help.zh: 默认关。自定义动画 / 静帧的代码默认只准 import 画图用的模块(manim、math、numpy …),不准读写文件、起进程、动态执行。这只是护栏、不是沙箱;打开后任何 Python 都会以你的身份在本机运行。
help.en: Off by default. Custom animation / still code may only import drawing modules (manim, math, numpy …) and may not read or write files, start processes or run dynamic code. This is a guardrail, not a sandbox; when on, any Python runs on this computer as you.

description.zh: 在插件自己的数据目录里建 Python 环境、装锁定版本的 Manim,查 LaTeX,试渲一帧;缺什么(macOS 的 cairo、Linux 的开发包、LaTeX)逐条说怎么装。第一次要一到几分钟,之后几乎瞬间完成。渲染工具不会顺手装环境,第一次请先跑它。
description.en: Creates a Python environment in the plugin's data directory, installs the pinned Manim, checks LaTeX and renders a test frame; anything missing (cairo on macOS, dev packages on Linux, LaTeX) comes back with how to install it. The first run takes a few minutes; later runs are near-instant. The render tools do not install anything, so run this first.

description.zh: 删掉插件的环境重新装。环境坏了(升级 Mosael 后 Python 变了)时用。
description.en: Delete the plugin's environment and install again — for a broken environment.

description.zh: 给结构化的教学内容,出一段 Manim 讲解视频(mp4,进素材库),不用写代码:标题页 → 一步一步讲(每步:标题、旁白字幕、逐条出现的要点,再配一样:LaTeX 公式、函数图像或逐处高亮的代码)→ 要点回顾。每步多长按旁白的朗读时长自动算;返回每一步的实际起止时间(steps),可选同时出 .srt 字幕,方便配音对时间。本机没装 LaTeX 时公式写成一行纯文字,照样出片。默认 720p,智能体调用时别选 production / 4k。
description.en: Turns structured teaching content into a Manim explainer video (mp4, into the asset library), no code needed: a title card, then steps (each with a title, narration captions, points revealed one by one, plus one visual: LaTeX formulas, a function plot or code highlighted stop by stop), then key takeaways. Step length follows the narration's reading time; returns each step's actual start and end (steps) and optionally an .srt file to sync a voice-over. Without LaTeX on this computer formulas are shown as plain text. 720p by default; avoid production / 4k when called by the agent.

description.zh: 标题页的大标题,最多 80 字。
description.en: Title-card heading, up to 80 characters.

description.zh: 标题页的副标题,一句话说清讲什么。
description.en: Title-card subtitle: one line on what it covers.

description.zh: 标题上方的小标签,如「数学 · 第 3 课」。
description.en: Small tag above the title, e.g. "Maths · Lesson 3".

description.zh: 一步一步讲的内容,1 到 20 步。每步的公式、函数图、代码三样最多放一样。
description.en: The steps, 1 to 20. Each step holds at most one of formulas, plot or code.

description.zh: 这一步的标题。
description.en: Step title.

description.zh: 这一步的旁白,显示成底部字幕,也决定这一步多长(最多 600 字)。
description.en: Narration for this step, shown as a caption; it also sets the step's length (up to 600 characters).

description.zh: 要点,随旁白逐条出现,最多 6 条。
description.en: Points revealed along the narration, up to 6.

description.zh: LaTeX 公式,最多 3 条(如 a^2 + b^2 = c^2),逐条书写出来。不能用 \input、\def 这类命令。
description.en: LaTeX formulas, up to 3 (e.g. a^2 + b^2 = c^2), written out one by one. Commands such as \input or \def are not allowed.

description.zh: 画一条函数曲线。
description.en: Plot a function.

description.zh: 关于 x 的算式,如 sin(x) + x^2/8、exp(-x^2/2)、1/x。能用 sin cos tan exp log sqrt abs 等函数与 pi、e。
description.en: An expression in x, e.g. sin(x) + x^2/8, exp(-x^2/2), 1/x. Functions such as sin cos tan exp log sqrt abs and pi, e are available.

description.zh: 默认 -5。
description.en: Default -5.

description.zh: 默认 5。
description.en: Default 5.

description.zh: 留空按曲线自动定。
description.en: Automatic when empty.

description.zh: 留空按曲线自动定。
description.en: Automatic when empty.

description.zh: 曲线旁的文字,默认「y = 算式」。
description.en: Text beside the curve; "y = expression" by default.

description.zh: 一段带语法高亮的代码,最多 30 行。
description.en: A syntax-highlighted snippet, up to 30 lines.

description.zh: 代码原文。
description.en: The source.

description.zh: 语言(Pygments 的名字),默认 python。
description.en: Language (a Pygments name), python by default.

description.zh: 讲解时依次框住的行:行号或「起-止」,如 [2, "4-6", 9]。
description.en: Lines boxed in turn during the step: line numbers or "start-end", e.g. [2, "4-6", 9].

description.zh: 这一步的时长(秒)。留空按旁白自动算;给了也不会短于动画本身。
description.en: Step length in seconds. Automatic from the narration when empty; never shorter than the animation itself.

description.zh: 结尾的要点回顾,最多 6 条。
description.en: Key takeaways at the end, up to 6.

description.zh: 默认横屏 16:9;竖屏短视频用 9:16。
description.en: 16:9 by default; 9:16 for vertical short video.
Short edge 480 / 720 (default) / 1080 / 1440 / 2160 pixels. Higher takes longer.

description.zh: 默认 30(low 画质 15)。
description.en: 30 by default (15 at low quality).

description.zh: 深色(默认)或浅色。
description.en: Dark (default) or light.

description.zh: 强调色 #RRGGBB。
description.en: Accent colour, #RRGGBB.

description.zh: 字体名(本机装了的),留空自动挑一款中英文都好看的无衬线体。
description.en: Font family installed on this computer; empty picks a sans-serif that suits Chinese and English.

description.zh: 旁白显示成底部字幕,默认开。另配字幕时关掉。
description.en: Show narration as captions (on by default). Turn off when adding subtitles separately.

description.zh: 同时交出一份按旁白切好的 .srt 字幕。
description.en: Also hand back an .srt file cut from the narration.

description.zh: 产出文件名,留空用 explainer.mp4。
description.en: Output file name; explainer.mp4 when empty.

description.zh: 用一段 Manim(社区版 0.21)场景代码渲染动画(进素材库)。代码里定义 `class 名字(Scene)`,在 `construct(self)` 里 `self.play(...)`;`from manim import *` 即可,调用时给的 data 用 `from mosael import DATA` 读。默认只准 import manim、math、numpy 等画图模块,不准读写文件、起进程。报错会指出是第几行哪句代码,改了再调。**会在本机执行 Python 代码**,默认不开放。讲解类内容优先用「Manim 讲解视频」。
description.en: Renders a Manim (Community 0.21) scene from Python code (into the asset library). Define `class Name(Scene)` and `self.play(...)` in `construct(self)`; `from manim import *` is enough, and the data given here is `from mosael import DATA`. By default only drawing modules (manim, math, numpy …) may be imported and files or processes are off limits. Errors point at the line and code, so fix and call again. **Runs Python code on this computer**; off by default. Prefer the explainer tool for lesson-style content.

description.zh: Python 源码,至少一个 Scene 子类。
description.en: Python source with at least one Scene subclass.

description.zh: 渲染哪个场景类;代码里只有一个时可留空。
description.en: Which scene class to render; may be empty when there is only one.
16:9 by default.
Short edge 480 / 720 (default) / 1080 / 1440 / 2160 pixels.

description.zh: 默认 30(low 画质 15)。
description.en: 30 by default (15 at low quality).

description.zh: 默认 mp4。
description.en: mp4 by default.

description.zh: 透明背景(用于叠加);mp4 会自动改成 mov。
description.en: Transparent background for overlays; mp4 becomes mov.

description.zh: 交给场景的数据,代码里 `from mosael import DATA`。
description.en: Data for the scene: `from mosael import DATA` in the code.

description.zh: 产出文件名,留空用 animation。
description.en: Output file name; animation when empty.

description.zh: 和「Manim 自定义动画」同样给一段场景代码,只要最后一帧(PNG,进素材库):几何图、函数图、示意图、封面。可以透明背景。同样会在本机执行代码,默认不开放。
description.en: Same scene code as the custom animation tool, but only the last frame (PNG, into the asset library): diagrams, plots, covers. Supports a transparent background. Also runs code on this computer; off by default.

description.zh: Python 源码,至少一个 Scene 子类。
description.en: Python source with at least one Scene subclass.

description.zh: 渲染哪个场景类;只有一个时可留空。
description.en: Which scene class; may be empty when there is only one.
16:9 by default.
Short edge 480 / 720 (default) / 1080 / 1440 / 2160 pixels.

description.zh: 透明背景。
description.en: Transparent background.

description.zh: 交给场景的数据,代码里 `from mosael import DATA`。
description.en: Data for the scene: `from mosael import DATA` in the code.

description.zh: 产出文件名,留空用 frame。
description.en: Output file name; frame when empty.
